llm_response.reason: The domain 'midasbuynew.com' mimics the legitimate brand 'Midasbuy' by adding 'new', a common tactic used by scammers to deceive users into believing they are accessing a trusted service. The inaccessibility of content (403 status) further adds to suspicion. These factors, along with potential unrealistic claims and ambiguous information typical of scam websites, suggest that this URL is being used as part of a fraudulent scheme.
